name: types
label: Event types

options.label: Operation finished (an import, clip generation or export)
Finishing finished (best clips exported and copy written)
Social post finished (needs the publishing:read permission)

help: Which Workspace Events start the scenario. Add a filter after this module to narrow them, for example Operation kind equal to generation for clips that are ready.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: The maximum number of events to work with during one execution cycle. Events arrive oldest first and none are skipped: any beyond the limit come in the next cycle.
